name: React
description: A declarative, component-based JavaScript library for building fast, interactive user interfaces out of reusable pieces.

name: Next.js
description: A React framework that adds routing, server rendering, and image optimisation so you can ship production apps faster.

name: Node.js
description: A JavaScript runtime built on Chrome's V8 engine that lets you run server-side code and build fast network applications.

name: Express.js
description: A minimal, unopinionated web framework for Node.js used to build APIs and web servers with very little boilerplate.

name: Django
description: A batteries-included Python web framework that handles authentication, an admin panel, and an ORM right out of the box.

name: PostgreSQL
description: A powerful, open-source object-relational database system known for reliability, extensibility, and strict data integrity.

name: MongoDB
description: A document-oriented NoSQL database that stores flexible, JSON-like records, making it easy to evolve your schema over time.

name: Redis
description: An in-memory key-value store used for caching, session storage, and message queues where every millisecond counts.

name: TypeScript
description: A typed superset of JavaScript that catches mistakes at compile time and makes large codebases easier to navigate.

name: Python
description: A readable, general-purpose language with a huge ecosystem, popular for web backends, scripting, and data work alike.

name: Tailwind CSS
description: A utility-first CSS framework that lets you style components directly in your markup without writing custom class names.

name: Sass
description: A CSS preprocessor that adds variables, nesting, and mixins, keeping large stylesheets organised and easy to reuse.

name: Docker
description: A containerisation platform that packages your app and its dependencies together so it runs the same on every machine.

name: Git
description: A distributed version control system that tracks every change to your code and makes collaborating with a team painless.

name: Figma
description: A collaborative interface design tool where designers and developers can prototype, comment, and hand off screens together.
